name: olivertwins-RE
install:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  root=.
elif [ -f magicianedit/package-lock.json ]; then
  root=magicianedit
elif [ -f repos/magicianedit/package-lock.json ]; then
  root=repos/magicianedit
else
  echo "package-lock.json not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi
cd "$root"
npm ci
start:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -f package.json ]; then
  root=.
elif [ -f magicianedit/package.json ]; then
  root=magicianedit
elif [ -f repos/magicianedit/package.json ]; then
  root=repos/magicianedit
else
  echo "package.json not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi
cd "$root"
exec npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173
